crown_trout.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: fantasy RPG inventory item icon, crown_trout.
Primary request: A fresh whole rainbow trout, slender gently curved body with fine silver scales, olive blue speckled back, distinct rosy pink lateral stripe, ivory belly, spotted fan tail and fine translucent fins.
Style: detailed hand-painted game item illustration with layered colors, careful scale and fin texture, readable shaped highlights and dark contour edges. Not a photograph or a 3D render.
Composition: one single fish only, side view angled diagonally from tail at lower left to head at upper right, centered in a square canvas, entire silhouette visible with generous transparent padding. Fill about 80 percent of the canvas. Keep the fish broad and readable at 48 pixels.
Background: true transparent alpha background. No solid backdrop, checkerboard, ground plane, cast shadow, plate, garnish, tools, splashes, scenery, text, labels, border, or watermark.
crown_trout.sourceLookup: Generated for the surviving T30 trout, T40 tuna, and T60 salmon catalogue in game/src/content/crownwardFishing.ts under docs/item-icons.md. Each raw, cooked, and burnt icon has a separate built-in image_gen prompt. Art direction follows species, cooking state, and compact inventory readability.
crown_trout.review: Pending root visual review of 256px masters and 48px production derivatives, followed by production inventory acceptance.
